body:
make a raving 8bit johnny bravo

Production adaptation: The text above defines the visual idea and action. For this call output only ONE PNG SPRITE SHEET, NOT a GIF file: exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 equal square cells, chronological row-major order. No border, grid lines, gutters, frame numbers, timestamps, or extra text. Fixed camera and ground line unless the action explicitly moves the camera. Keep scale, character identity, palette and geometry consistent; each cell is one distinctly different consecutive animation pose with nothing crossing cell boundaries. Cells will be extracted and encoded locally afterward. Make the motion return naturally from the final cell to the first.
A single muscular adult Johnny Bravo in a black tee, blue jeans, sunglasses and tall blond pompadour. Eight different pixel poses: left step, arm pump, right step, arm pump, hips left, hips right, crouch bounce, starting stance. Fixed white background, no writing.

en.title: Johnny Bravo eight-bit dance — composed GIF
en.description: 9 frames, 0.8 seconds, 443×443px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.
en.body:
## How to use

Use the complete adapted prompt without a reference image.

Reuse the archived GPT Image sheet and resample its action to nine frames. Sources with eight poses split one held pose across two encoded frames without adding a new pose; longer sequences select nine chronological poses. Preserve total duration and loop settings. Small source cells are enlarged for display without adding detail. The GIF is composed locally; the image tool returned a still PNG. The source sheet, exact crops, frame delays and first-frame poster are retained in the campaign archive.

## Result and limitations

9 frames, 0.8 seconds, 443×443px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.

Reviewed all nine-frame sequences in four contact sheets: action order, identity, captions and final poses retained. This output reuses archived GPT Image source pixels; no new provider call. One held pose is split into two frames; eight distinct source poses, nine encoded frames. Total duration and playback count preserved. Original source review (frame counts describe source only): Eight recognizable pixel-art Johnny Bravo poses show alternating steps, arm pumps, hip shifts and crouch bounce. Entire character visible; no text. Actual 800 ms loop, silent. Sprite shapes have small redraw variation; no claim of source audio.

## Source

Adapted by Prompt Seen from [@thealexbanks's original prompt](https://x.com/thealexbanks/status/2118755226555490395). The author labels the source work Image 2.6; this run only establishes the GPT Image family, with no exact model ID. The prompt preserves its submitted language on both page editions. Likes describe the whole source post, shared by variants, and are not engagement for this example.

## 使用方法

使用完整改编词，无需参考图。

复用已生成的 GPT Image 精灵图，统一合成 9 帧：8 姿态素材将一次停留拆成两个编码帧，不新增姿态，较长序列按顺序选取 9 帧。保留总时长与循环设置，小尺寸素材仅放大显示，不增加细节。生图工具返回静态 PNG；GIF 由本地合成。原精灵图、裁切坐标、逐帧时长与首帧封面均保存在批次档案。

## 结果与限制

9 帧，0.8 秒，443×443 像素，无限循环；GPT Image 精灵图逐格裁切并在本地编码为 GIF。

原始素材审核说明（以下帧数和尺寸指原始版本；当前交付统一为 9 帧）：8 帧静音像素舞蹈，不含原帖后配音乐；人物细节略有重绘变化。

## 来源

由 Prompt Seen 根据 [@thealexbanks 的原词](https://x.com/thealexbanks/status/2118755226555490395)改编。来源作者称原作品使用 Image 2.6；本次仅确认 GPT Image 家族，精确型号未知。中英文页面保留同一实际提交正文。点赞属于整篇来源帖，同帖变体共享统计对象，不属于本站新作品。
